note: Franklin County IA (FIPS 19069) publishes zoning only as unofficial PDF map atlases (2018). Its GIS office says zoning boundaries exist as an ESRI shapefile, but only through a paid/order request form (Schneider GeoPermits), not a public download or queryable service. The county ArcGIS Online org (services7 vkK9gWXr5NOvX1LA) lists no zoning layer. Hampton (county seat) publishes its zoning districts only as a PDF; no city zoning service found for Hampton, Sheffield or Ackley. A Zoning_Districts FeatureServer found in search (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) has no features in the county and is not this county's data.
